Datia Bypoll: Congress Suspends Ex-MLA, Election Results Awaited

Ahead of the Datia by-election results, the Congress party suspended former MLA Rajendra Bharti for six years, citing allegations of internal sabotage. Bharti, a three-time former MLA, had previously lost his membership due to a conviction. While some reports indicate the Congress candidate defeated the BJP by 6,000 votes in Datia, others noted early trends showing a BJP lead. The election outcome is being discussed in relation to the political future of BJP leader Narottam Mishra, with some outlets suggesting potential changes in the state cabinet post-result.
